title: Commercial Insurance Sales Executive
salary_text: £40000 - £50000 per year (+ 5% commission on all sales)
description:
Commercial Insurance Sales Executive
Takeley, Essex £40,000 £50,000 Basic + Commission Permanent

Do you have a successful track record in insurance sales and enjoy building relationships that turn into long-term business?

CKB Recruitment is working with an established insurance agency in Takeley to recruit a Commercial Insurance Sales Executive.

This is an opportunity to take ownership of your new business activity within an ambitious, supportive team. You ll build relationships with business owners and decision-makers, understand their insurance requirements and develop solutions that demonstrate the value of quality cover and personal service.

Experienced account handlers will support the clients you bring on board through their renewals, giving you confidence in the ongoing service behind your sales.

The opportunity

You ll play a key role in growing the agency s commercial client base, focusing on businesses outside the farming sector.

Your responsibilities will include:
- Generating your own opportunities and maintaining a consistent pipeline of commercial prospects.
- Building relationships with business owners, directors and key decision-makers.
- Understanding each client s business and presenting tailored insurance solutions.
- Converting prospects into clients through a consultative sales approach.
- Identifying cross-selling opportunities across motor and personal insurance, risk management and financial services.
- Maintaining accurate records using the CRM system and working within a regulated environment.
- Working closely with account handlers to support a smooth handover and ongoing client service.

What we re looking for

An insurance sales background is essential, alongside a proven track record of winning new business.

You ll be proactive, commercially aware and comfortable creating your own opportunities. You ll also bring:
- Confident communication and relationship-building skills.
- The ability to explain the value of cover and service clearly.
- A self-motivated approach and the drive to maintain a healthy sales pipeline.
- A commitment to excellent customer service and long-term relationships.
- The ability to learn products quickly and retain technical information.
- Confidence using business software and CRM systems.

You ll also need at least five GCSEs, including English Language and Mathematics, meeting the employer s stated minimum grade requirements.

The package
- £40,000 £50,000 basic salary, depending on experience.
- 5% commission on commercial new business sold.
- 25 days holiday plus bank holidays.
- An additional day off for your birthday.
- Health cash plan following successful completion of probation.
- Full product training, with potential financial support towards professional qualifications.
- A supportive team with experienced account handlers looking after renewal business.

Working hours: Monday to Friday, 9am 5pm, with a one-hour lunch break. Reduced or condensed hours may be considered for an exceptional candidate.

To explore the opportunity, apply with your CV through CKB Recruitment for a confidential conversation.

title: Sales Executive
description:
Sales Executive - Fabrication

Location: Hockley, Essex

Salary: 32,000 - 37,000 - DOE

Hours: Full-time, permanent

Benefits: Up-capped commision on top of base salary.

Our client is a specialist business working with bespoke ceramic sheets, including assembly, shaping and lettering to meet customer requirements. Due to continued business growth, they are looking to appoint a Sales Executive to support their expansion and drive new business opportunities.

This is a newly created position, offering an excellent opportunity for someone with experience in the Fabrication industry to join a close-knit team and play an important role in the company's continued success.

Working closely with the existing office team, the successful candidate will focus mainly on business development i.e. outbound sales, developing customer relationships and securing larger orders. Full training will be provided on the company's software.

Sales Executive - Position Overview
- Make outbound sales calls to prospective and existing customers to generate new business opportunities.
- Meet potential clients and build relationships face-to-face.
- Identify potential customers and develop relationships to secure larger orders.
- Proactively follow up on sales enquiries, quotations and potential orders.
- Build and maintain strong customer relationships within the fabrication industry.
- Understand customer requirements and communicate the company's products and services effectively.
- Work closely with the office and warehouse teams to support the smooth progression of customer orders.
- Maintain accurate customer records, sales activity and follow-up tasks using software.
- Identify opportunities to increase sales and contribute to the continued growth of the business.
- Manage sales activity independently, prioritising leads and following up opportunities effectively.

Sales Executive - Position Requirements
- Previous experience within the ceramics industry is highly desirable.
- Previous sales, telesales, business development or account management experience.
- Confident making outbound calls and engaging with prospective customers.
- Strong communication and relationship-building skills.
- Proactive, commercially minded and motivated to generate new business.
- Organised, with the ability to manage multiple enquiries and sales opportunities.
- Comfortable using computer systems, with a willingness to learn Zoho software; training will be provided.

The Opportunity

This is an excellent opportunity to join a growing specialist business in a newly created sales role. The successful candidate will have the opportunity to develop the sales function, build valuable industry relationships and make a tangible contribution to the company's expansion.

The role will be office-based to allow for training and integration with the team, with the opportunity to move towards having your own sales team.

title: Sales Account Executive
company: THE PLUMBING DISTRIBUTION COMPANY LTD - Agency - Permanent
description:
Job Title: Sales Account Executive

Location: Chelmsford, Essex

Salary: £35,000 basic salary + uncapped monthly bonus (realistic OTE £40,000 - £50,000+)

Job type: Permanent, Full Time. Monday-Friday, 9:00am-5:00pm, with no weekend work.

The Plumbing Distribution Company Ltd (PDC) is a successful, family-run B2 B distribution business that has proudly served plumbing merchants since 2006.

We are built around gold-standard service, reliability, trust and continuous improvement. After 20 years of growth, we are entering an exciting new period of expansion.

We are now looking for an ambitious and commercially driven Sales Account Executive to join our team and play a key role in the next stage of PDC's development.

The Role:

This is a proactive B2 B sales position responsible for managing and developing an established customer portfolio while identifying new business opportunities.

You will build strong relationships with plumbing and builders' merchants, increase account performance, reactivate dormant customers and generate new business across the UK.

Working closely with Operations, Purchasing, Logistics and Management, you will become a trusted point of contact for your customers while contributing directly to company sales and gross profit targets.

We are looking for someone who is confident speaking with customers, commercially minded and motivated by measurable results, while maintaining PDC's high standards of service.

Key Responsibilities
- Manage and develop an established portfolio of plumbing and builders' merchant customers.
- Achieve agreed sales, revenue and account growth targets.
- Handle inbound sales enquiries by telephone, email, WhatsApp and customer portal.
- Proactively contact existing, dormant and prospective customers to generate new business.
- Build relationships with key customer decisionmakers.
- Identify upselling, cross-selling and product promotion opportunities.
- Prepare quotations and follow up opportunities to maximise conversion.
- Manage the sales process from enquiry through to order completion.
- Identify and secure new merchant accounts across the UK.
- Reactivate dormant and develop underperforming customer accounts.
- Maintain regular customer contact through a structured monthly call programme.
- Follow up all quotations within 48 hours.
- Maintain accurate CRM records and sales activity.
- Monitor account performance, opportunities and pipeline development.
- Work with internal departments to resolve customer, stock, delivery and service issues.

Performance Expectations

Success in this role will be driven by consistent customer engagement, proactive account management and commercial performance.

You will be expected to maintain structured customer contact and achieve agreed activity and sales targets. Typical activity levels will include 50-70 customer conversations per day alongside ownership of a monthly account contact programme.

Performance will be measured through sales revenue, gross profit growth, account development, customer retention, new account acquisition and agreed activity targets.

About You:

To be successful, you will need:
- Previous experience in B2 B sales, account management, business development, internal sales or telesales.
- Experience managing and developing customer accounts.
- Strong communication and relationship-building skills.
- Confidence engaging customers and influencing purchasing decisions.
- A professional telephone manner and excellent verbal communication.
- Commercial awareness and a results-focused approach.
- Strong organisational, planning and time-management skills.
- Experience using CRM systems and Microsoft Office.
- A proactive, resilient and persistent approach to sales.
- The ability to manage multiple priorities and work to targets.
- A practical, customer-focused approach to problem solving.

Experience within plumbing, heating, construction products, merchanting or distribution would be advantageous.

We are looking for someone who takes ownership, consistently delivers on commitments and maintains high professional standards. Most importantly, you will share our commitment to outstanding customer service through product knowledge, responsiveness, reliability and a customer-first mindset.

What We Offer:
- Established customer portfolio to manage and develop.
- Clear and achievable sales targets.
- Structured training and ongoing professional development.
- In-house certifications and skills development opportunities.
- Supportive environment where ideas, accountability and continuous improvement are valued.
- Genuine long-term career progression opportunities.
- Monday-Friday working hours with no weekend work.
- Opportunity to join a growing family-run business.

Apply Today:

If you are an ambitious sales professional looking to develop customer relationships, win new business, increase account performance and earn through your results, we would love to hear from you.

PDC is committed to a fair and inclusive recruitment process. If you require a reasonable adjustment to participate in any stage of the recruitment process, please let us know.

Applicants will be required to demonstrate their right to work in the UK as part of the recruitment process.

Please click APPLY to be redirected to our platform in order to complete your application.

Candidates with the relevant experience or job titles of Sales Account Executive, Account Manager, Internal Sales Executive, Sales Executive, Business Development Executive, or Sales Representative will also be considered for this role.
